data.one_liner: Lint rules for Dart and Flutter used internally at Very Good Ventures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of lints for Dart and Flutter projects, along with automatic trailing comma configuration for the Dart formatter. It helps maintain code quality and consistency across a codebase.
use_when: You want a standardized, opinionated set of lint rules for Dart and Flutter projects
You want to configure automatic trailing commas for the Dart formatter
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter lints or a custom linter configuration without strict rules
strengths: Promotes clean, consistent code and best practices used by Very Good Ventures
Configures automatic trailing commas out of the box
Provides instructions for suppressing lints at the line, file, or project level
weaknesses: Some rules are excluded due to experimental status, deprecation, or false positives
Opinionated defaults may require overriding for certain code styles
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml and include the rules in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official lint rules recommended by the Flutter team.
